prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of key proposals (non-exhaustive)

Economy and business
- Industrial strategy focused on green infrastructure, innovation and skills; repair trade ties with Europe; protect Bank of England independence; OBR forecasts for fiscal events.
- Home Energy Upgrade to cut bills; National Food Strategy; target tax cuts via higher personal allowance when affordable.
- Tax changes: reverse bank tax cuts; one-off windfall tax on oil/gas; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; fairer capital gains rules; 4% levy on FTSE-100 share buybacks.
- Expand British Business Bank; Commercial Landowner Levy to replace business rates; prompt-payment enforcement; local banking; AI regulatory framework; Trade and Technology Council participation.
- Worker Protection Enforcement Authority; modernise gig-economy rights; improve Statutory Sick Pay; independent living wage review.
- Lifelong Skills Grants; replace apprenticeship levy with flexible skills levy; expand apprenticeships and technical routes.

Climate and energy
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030; rooftop solar expansion; zero‑carbon standards for new buildings; free insulation and heat pumps for low-income households.
- Social energy tariff; decouple electricity prices from gas; maintain bans on fracking/new coal; end fossil fuel subsidies; expand storage and interconnectors; support community energy.
- Net Zero Delivery Authority; Chief Secretary for Sustainability; UK ETS linkage with EU; Carbon Border Adjustment.

Health and care
- Right to see a GP within 7 days (24 hours urgent); recruit 8,000 GPs; expand pharmacy/nurse prescribing; digital booking.
- NHS dentistry access for urgent care; contract reform; children’s supervised brushing; remove VAT on children’s dental products.
- Youth mental health hubs nationwide; mental health check-ups at key life stages; school mental health leads; end out-of-area placements.
- Cancer: 62‑day treatment guarantee; more radiotherapy machines; cancer nurses; faster access to new treatments.
- Hospital and IT upgrades; shared records with consent; strategic diagnostics plan; shift drugs policy to health; regulated cannabis market.
- Social care: free personal care; workforce plan; Royal College of Care Workers; Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/h); unpaid carers’ leave and respite; National Care Agency; transferable care packages.

Education and families
- Mental health professional in every school; per‑pupil funding rises; school repairs; “Tutoring Guarantee” for disadvantaged pupils.
- Early years: extra 5 free hours for disadvantaged 3–4s; triple Early Years Pupil Premium; nursery workforce strategy; childminding simplification.
- Teacher workforce strategy; funded, independent pay review; paid training posts; curriculum and assessment reform; stronger SEND support and funding.
- Reinstate university maintenance grants; Erasmus+ return; Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000 initially).
- Parental leave/pay as day‑one rights (incl. self‑employed); double Statutory Maternity/Shared Parental Pay to £350/week; paternity at 90% pay; extra month for partners; neonatal leave.
- Extend free school meals to all children in poverty.

Pensions and welfare
- Remove two‑child limit and benefit cap; 5‑day wait for first Universal Credit payment; scrap bedroom tax; replace sanctions with incentive‑based support.
- Protect pension triple lock; address 1950s women’s pensions; increase and widen Carer’s Allowance; disability benefit and assessment reforms.

Crime and justice
- Restore community policing; guarantee police attendance/investigation for burglaries; invest to cut court backlogs; strengthen rehabilitation and probation.
- Online Crime Agency; scrap Police and Crime Commissioners (replace with local Police Boards); Hillsborough Law; targets on police diversity; domestic abuse specialists; mental‑health handover targets.

Environment, food and farming
- Transform water companies into public benefit companies; new regulator; sewage tax; binding 2030 targets for bathing waters; real‑time discharge data.
- Double nature by 2050; 60m trees/year; Clean Air Act; stronger environmental watchdogs.
- Accelerate Environmental Land Management with +£1bn/year; uphold farm and food standards in trade; EU veterinary and plant‑health agreements; stronger Groceries Code Adjudicator; fisheries sustainability.

Housing and local government
- Build 380,000 homes/year incl. 150,000 social; 10 new garden cities; councils to buy land at existing‑use value; “use‑it‑or‑lose‑it” permissions; zero‑carbon homes.
- Ban no‑fault evictions; default 3‑year tenancies; national landlord register; abolish leasehold and cap ground rents; remove dangerous cladding at no cost to leaseholders.
- End rough sleeping; stronger controls on second homes/short‑lets; universal gigabit broadband.

Transport
- Speed up EV charging rollout; restore plug‑in grant; 2030 zero‑emission sales requirement; cut VAT on public charging to 5%.
- Freeze rail fares; fare simplification; Northern Powerhouse Rail; rail electrification; zero‑emission buses; nationwide active travel plan; more road‑maintenance funding.
- Reform air taxes to focus on frequent flyers; super tax on private jets; ban short flights where rail <2.5h (unless alternative‑fuelled).

Culture, immigration, rights, democracy, defence, international
- Protect BBC/S4C/Alba/Channel 4; Creative Europe participation; anti‑SLAPP law; football regulator; stronger gambling controls.
- Scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda scheme; 3‑month asylum decision standard; work rights after 3 months; expand safe/legal routes; reform work visas; reverse family visa threshold rises; Windrush redress.
- Uphold Human Rights Act and ECHR; ban conversion practices; modernise gender recognition; stronger legal aid; Digital Bill of Rights.
- Proportional representation (STV) for MPs and English councils; cap donations; Lords reform; wider devolution; transparency reforms.
- Increase defence spending toward 2.5% GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls; EU/NATO cooperation.
- Restore 0.7% aid; support Ukraine (incl. seizing Russian assets); repair EU ties via staged roadmap toward Single Market; recognise Palestine; advocate Israel‑Gaza ceasefire; targeted human‑rights sanctions.
